name: Bread omelette (masala omelette with bread)

source.name: Swasthi's Recipes (indianhealthyrecipes.com)
source.license: Ingredient amounts as listed in the cited recipe, converted to grams; nutrients composed from USDA FoodData Central (CC0)

notes: Serves 1. Recipe says 2 to 3 slices brown bread; 2 slices of whole wheat bread at 32 g each used. 2 large eggs 100 g; 1 tbsp oil 14 g; salt as needed taken as 1 g; 1/8 tsp turmeric 0.4 g; 1/8 tsp black pepper 0.3 g; 2 tbsp onion 20 g; 1 tbsp capsicum 9 g (green bell pepper); 1 green chili 5 g; 1 tbsp coriander 1 g. Optional chaat masala, butter, cheese, ketchup and herbs left out. About 8% of the weight is lost as steam while frying.
